findings.defect: Thin ligament between mounting holes and outer knurl
findings.evidence: Top view at 12 and 6 oclock; thickness report confirms 0.40–0.47 mm wall.
findings.repair: Move mounting centers inward 0.5 mm and add local inward bosses, preserving OD70.

observation: The ring is concentric and finely knurled, but both mounting holes nearly break through the outer rim.
